title: C¹ images of C¹ level sets are countably k-rectifiable for Lᵐ-a.e. y (Simon Ch. 2, Thm 6.4; Ch. 3, Remark 2.10(2))
statement: Let m, k ∈ ℕ with k > 0, n := m + k, N ∈ ℕ, D ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N of class C¹ on D, and G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ of class C¹. Then for Lᵐ-a.e. y ∈ ℝᵐ the set ψ(D ∩ G⁻¹{y}) is countably k-rectifiable (SimonGMT CountablyRectifiable k in ℝ^N). Notation (as in the parent): ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hˢ = μHE[s] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet; P* = LinearMap.adjoint P; DF(u) = fderiv ℝ F u.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), 0 < k → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), CountablyRectifiable k (ψ '' (D ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}))
